(3)  The  rules  of  the  Foundation  in  force  on  the  day

7.
(1) The Corporation shall have its own fund and all
moneys  heretofore  or  hereafter  to  be  received  by  way  of
testamentary disposition, donations, contributions and  fees
deposited  in  the  name  of  the  Corporation  in  one  or  more
Banks as  the Board of Directors shall determine.
(2) There  shall  be  paid  out  from  the  fund,  all  sums  of
moneys  to  defray  any  expenditure  incurred  by  the
Corporation in the exercise, performance and discharge of its
powers, duties and functions under this Act.
